Case Study

Vepaar: Everything You Need to Run Online Business

We identified a market gap that was keeping small businesses offline and turned it into an opportunity that led to 100K+ app downloads globally.

{/* Overview & The Idea Section */}

The Idea - Turning WhatsApp into a Complete Business Tool

Vepaar began with a simple question: why can’t small businesses use WhatsApp to do everything they already do in-store? We noticed thousands of sellers relying on WhatsApp for customer communication but lacking tools for catalogs, orders, or payments. Vepaar bridges this gap by bringing together everything you need to sell online.

Key Capabilities

Selling Made Easy

  • Variable & Digital Products
  • Custom Checkout Configurations
  • Inventory & Stock Management
  • Coupon Code Generation

WhatsApp CRM

  • Customer Profile Building
  • Sales Funnels & Tags
  • AutoSave Chat Integration
  • Exportable Synced Chats
